title: A. Navas: A Conjecture on Delone Sets BL to Lattices (after P. Alestalo, D.A. Trotsenko and J. V\"ais\"al\"a). — Problem
exact_target: Can a bi-Lipschitz correspondence between a planar Delone set and the lattice be realized by a bi-Lipschitz map of the whole plane?
